reading.rtitle: Welcome, Mr. Leão -- what you can do here
paras: Dear Mr. Leão, welcome to the Harbor Hotel. Here is some information for your stay with us.
You can use the pool from seven in the morning to ten at night. You can get a towel at the door of the pool, so you do not need to take one from your room.
The gym is on the second floor, and it is open all day and all night. You can use it with your room key.
The Wi-Fi is free. The password is on your key card. If you can't connect, you can call the front desk: just press zero.
Our laundry can wash your clothes in one day. Put them in the bag in your room before nine in the morning.
Please remember: smoking is not allowed in the rooms, and you can't bring food from outside into the restaurant.
Checkout is at twelve. If your flight is late, you can leave your bags with us, or you can ask for a late checkout. Have a wonderful stay!

listenings.text: Good afternoon, and welcome to the Grand Park Hotel. This is Anna, from the front desk. Here are three things for your first night. First, the restaurant is on the first floor, and you can have dinner from seven to eleven. You can't pay with cash in the restaurant, only with a card. Second, the swimming pool is on the roof. It is open until nine, and you can get a towel there. Third, the gym is next to the elevator, and you can use it all night with your key. If you need anything, you can call me. Just press zero. Have a good evening.

I travel a lot, and my English is not perfect. But I can do a lot of things. I can check in at a hotel, I can ask for the Wi-Fi password, and I can order food in a restaurant. I can understand people when they speak slowly. But I can't understand fast English on the phone, and I can't watch a movie without subtitles. Not yet. Last week I asked a receptionist: can you speak slowly, please? And she said: of course I can. That is my favorite sentence now. Can you speak slowly, please? It works everywhere.

extra_audio.text: Good evening. Can I ask you something? Can I use the pool now? Sorry, you can't. But you can use the gym. And what is the Wi-Fi password? It is on your key card. Have a good night!
